description:
On the way to school, http://anidb.net/ch23430 [Kokubu Karin], a junior-high school student, finds a piglet too hungry to move, so she feeds it. This pig is actually Prince http://anidb.net/ch23432 [Tonrariano III] from planet Booringo. He gives Karin a transformation kit, consisting of a piggy nose, to reward her kindness. Karin puts on the nose and says the magical words that Tonrariano III taught her, to transform into the mighty flying super-pig, http://anidb.net/ch23431 [Buurin]! But Karin is not happy to be a pig. Tonrariano III discusses the predicament with his father the King, who promises Karin that she can become her ideal super-heroine if she collects 100 pearls, which will be given to her one by one each time Buurin helps somebody.
And so Buurin, the mysterious super-pig, appears from out of nowhere when people are in trouble, and helps them. Although everyone is curious of the pig`s origins, nobody knows that Buurin is actually Karin... much to her relief.
Source: AnimeNfo

REGULAR.description: http://anidb.net/character/23430 [Kokubu Karin] is just an average junior high school student, until the day she saves a yellow piglet and receives a strange compact in return. She is to transform into a superhero with this compact, but what she transforms into is... a pig!? But when this super pig rescues a boy from a burning apartment she is cherished on by others.

Karin`s school is to have a soccer match with another school with a team well known for their tricks. http://anidb.net/character/23433 [Mizuno Kouichi], a core member of Karin`s team, is now the subject of the tricks. Can Buurin help his team win despite all these interferences from the rival team?

titles.title: The Shooting of Love and Youth

REGULAR.description: Karin and her best friend Masami had a fight during practice for an upcoming tennis match. However Karin is too shy to patch things up so she has to turn to Buurin for help.

titles.title: 涙と友情のスマッシュ

REGULAR.description: The neighbour park is to host a female pro-wrestling tournament. Among its participants there is a newbie who dresses up like Buurin. For some reason Karin ends up helping her in the practice...

All the year 1 classes at Karin`s school are joining forces in a planned tug-of-war match against Buurin, in the school`s athletic meet. But Buurin is having some trouble at hand and Kouichi, the organizer for this event, becomes very worried.
Karin unearthed a Buurin look-a-like statue during a history field trip. This tool brought her to an ancient ruins, where she dug up a great deal about the history about Buurin.

titles.title: 発見! ぶーりんの土偶

REGULAR.description: A Cutey Chao live show becomes a bit too exciting and dangerous with the intrusion of a genuine bank robber. Of course it takes more than a female superhero to subdue him.

Karin has been eating a little too much lately and becomes quite pig-like. After a mean comment from her crush Karin goes on diet like any girls would do. But she goes too far on this diet matter, and it drags down Buurin too...

Kuroha`s race circuit is opening with a solar car race. Karin and her mates built a solar car that looks like Buurin. As the race draws near the weather becomes unstable, and nobody is sure if their "solar Buurin" will make it to the finish line.

titles.title: サーキットの戦士たち

REGULAR.description: http://anidb.net/character/50261 [Kokubu Shin`ichirou], the editor-in-chief of Akebono Times,is well known as an enthusiastic journalist. In order to satisify the readers, he is always running around. Hunt for scoops! Until dead! Chase!! After Buurin!! Till the end of the earth!!

titles.title: The Fire of a Journalist`s Soul
炎のジャーナリスト魂

REGULAR.description: There is an additional part for the school`s culture fest: a best couple contest. Karin tries to win the contest with Kouichi by all means given the promises of a romantic meal for the winning couple.

titles.title: Who Will be the Best Couple?
ベストカップルを狙え!

REGULAR.description: Kashiwagi has been quite involved in supernatural power lately. A series of coincidences makes him think that he really has such power...
It`s test time again - oh yes, it`ll be pieces of cake if I become Buurin. Ehh? Ton-chan got a test too? If you fail that you will not get to be the king? No way, will my test end up that bad?

titles.title: 銀河に誓うミッション

REGULAR.description: Kouichi-kun and company are going to make a movie. Needless to say the leading actress is going to be Buurin.

titles.title: 拍手と喝采のテアトル

REGULAR.description: Kaoru-chan appeals, "Don`t throw garbage at the river bed!" She then called, "Let`s all clean it up!" But having received cold response, Kaoru decided to do the clean up herself. Don`t be downhearted, Kaoru! I, Buurin, will come and assist you!

titles.title: 若きもんぺ少女の嘆き

REGULAR.description: Here comes the long-awaited Christmas day. The chance to give Kouichi-kun the gift of love. Eh? Kouichi-kun can`t come to the party? Perhaps he has a date with someone? Huh? Buurin is his date!? No way, I won`t date him that way!
How will Kouichi-kun and I go along? Pleeeease, anyone please tell me the truth...

You have to starve since the new year. And you can`t return home because you`re broke. Why not come along! Hold a big new year party at Kokubu`s!! Hey, Ton-chan looks so depressed. What? You want to go back to Buuringo-sei?

titles.title: 新春ホームシック物語(ストーリー)

REGULAR.description: In winter we of course go skiing. And of course I like Kouichi-kun. That of course means we go together to a ski training camp!! What happened to Arashiyama-sensei? He`s fidgeting. What? You want to declare your love to Nanako-sensei!?

titles.title: Hakugin ni Mau Koi no Arashi

REGULAR.description: A big plant is covering up all the school, "Cosmonia Giga teriumu Keiko!" What will the humanity`s future really be?!
Kouichi-kun, who do you really like? My heart keep going round and round, I am getting dizzy already.
Hey Ton-chan, what are you writing? A-ha, perhaps a love letter? Oh yeah, must be for Tonzabesu on Buuringo-sei right. Huh! Not Tonzabesu!! Then, then who`s it for?

titles.title: トンちゃんの恋の行方

REGULAR.description: Buurin promised the owner of a cake shop to help out in a chocolate delivery campaign. The response is unexpectedly well, now that Karin might not have time left to deliver her own to Kouichi.

titles.title: 義理と勇気の2・14(バレンタイン)

REGULAR.description: Every year Kokubu Shin`ichirou waits at the freezing lake shore for the natural phenomenon called "Omiwatari". Karin and company go there as well, supporting him morally or otherwise. But the incidents afterwards become more and more unbelievable.

titles.title: 愛は御神(おみ)渡りを越えて

REGULAR.description: Which will be the Doll of Choice of Karin in this year`s Girl`s festival? The Kokubu family doll? Cutey Chao doll? Or is it Buurin doll?

titles.title: 果林が受け継ぐひな祭り

REGULAR.description: The name of the ideal tennis player Kondou-sensei has found is... Buurin?

titles.title: 好敵手(ライバル)はただ一人!

REGULAR.description: The mark on my tummy starts blinking again. I have to return ASAP to recharge. Huh? The puppy Gendai is still trapped inside? You didn`t said that before. All of a sudden it is all bright white before my eyes, and... where am I!?

titles.title: 衝撃! ぶーりん消滅!?

REGULAR.description: So this is Shuuhei`s girlfriend Hitomi-chan. She`s really nice and pretty eh? All-right, I`ll help bring you two together. All of a sudden Hitomi-chan`s older brother shows up. "Judo`s eighth rank, karate`s ninth rank, third-level abacus??" H... huh? Where did I heard that before...?

titles.title: 小さな恋の狂詩曲(ラプソディー)

REGULAR.description: Kuroha Keiko invited us all along for a trip to the southern paradise Hawaii. I`m very excited as this is my first trip overseas. I can surf the sea and dance Hawaiian dance, this is nothing but the highest enjoyment possible! Hee hee! Mike the instructor looks cute... No no no, I`m just kidding. Sorry Kouichi-kun.

titles.title: Tokonatsu no Shima e Shinro o Tore
常夏の島へ進路をとれ

REGULAR.description: There is a dreadful legend about Riibuu circulating in Hawaii. The secret of mysterious power that surpasses that of Buurin will be revealed soon!!

The school`s student council has not been welcomed by the students, and this year no one wants to run for presidency. But as Kuroha Keiko steps up to the challenge the whole school becomes full of election mood... and is going out of control!
Cheery blossom has some significance for Jimmy Matsumoto... a really big and bad significance! But nothing is forever, and cherry trees will flower again sometime.

titles.title: Junjou Shounen Osozaki no Koi Sakura
純情少年遅咲きの恋桜

REGULAR.description: The illness of the spring - hay fever - suddenly attacked one day. That one got it, this one got it, and Buurin ended up having it too! Ah-choo! Ah-choo!! And she even fails her role as the superheroine. Hey Ton-chan, what`s that ugly mask for...

titles.title: Hakujitsu ni Tadayou Kafun no Wana
白日に漂う花粉のワナ

REGULAR.description: Mizuno Kouichi and his teammates are high in spirit as they face their first championship match in their second year. However it seems that their teamwork has had a problem. They decide to try what carp streamers can do for them as Arashiyama-sensei tells them that they can bring them good luck.

titles.title: 泳げ友情のこいのぼり

REGULAR.description: Karin was kidnapped by two ninjas, leaving only a sock behind. This lead then brings her friends to Kyoto. Going around in Mushanokouji Takuma`s family abode they discovered one mystery after another, as well as Takuma`s brother Yumemaro. What will be Karin`s fate? The real secret that has been hidden all the time will soon be revealed!

I`m now up to the challenge of rice-planting! It should be a piece of cake once I exercise my power... Uh oh, so difficult. Huh? The legendary rice-planting music? It will be possible to do the job with it? So what is it? Tell me, tell me.

titles.title: Den`en ni Mau Megami no Densetsu
田園に舞う女神の伝説

REGULAR.description: It`s a big shock. Kouichi-kun wrote a love letter to Buurin! If so I`d rather be living married as Buurin! Grrrr... no way no way. If this is so, I cannot let Kouichi-kun and Buurin meet again!!

titles.title: 恋文は初恋の片道切符

REGULAR.description: Jimmy discovers a big comet in the starry sky. It shines red, and it looks like an apple... isn`t it Buuringo-sei!? In order to investigate he ventures deep into the mountain area. He drops into a mysterious dimension, then strange things happen one after another. What terrible secrets hide inside?

titles.title: Kindan no Tobira o Hiraku Otoko

REGULAR.description: There`s one, and here`s one. Look, there`s one over there too! There`s such a mark everywhere Buurin has been at. In order to reveal the truth behind the family emblem of the Mushanokouji family, Ton-chan and I head for Kyoto again! What is the new monster attacked in the cellar? And what kind of a person is Takuma-senpai`s ancestor?

Finally, Kashiwagi`s grandmother made her debut! She`s still very healthy even though she`s already 81. To make matter worse, she always chases after Buurin lecturing to her. Perhaps her true identity is an alien spying on Buurin`s secrets!?

titles.title: 主役(ヒロイン)になりそこねた女

REGULAR.description: Buurin`s true identity has finally been found! Based on bold assumptions and hypotheses, Matsumoto-kun sets out to investigate. He even goes as far as to use an all-embracing information network. Till when he has to be this persistent! A big crisis for Buurin!!

Another Buurin has landed in front of us. With a clear head and excellent record, any problems are a piece of cake for her! W-will there be a place for me? Even Ton-chan doesn`t know the true identity of this Buurin! And it`s now time for a showdown, who is going to win!?

Karin and her mates decides to brave the ghosts at the school midnight. They ended up venturing into the cellar of the gymnasium. Arashiyama-sensei and Buurin both have secrets down there that they don`t want revealed, so they play along and try to scare everyone away by playing ghosts.

titles.title: Kaidan, Manatsu no Yoru no Ayamachi
怪談・真夏の夜の過ち

REGULAR.description: Kuroha Keiko picked up a compact. It`s colour is so ugly, and it looks so stupid, it`s totally out of fashion. Hey hey, where did you found those things? But why is this compact so familiar... Aaahaaa!! But isn`t that my Tonpact!?

Here comes here comes here comes, here it comes finally! My time of becoming Cutey Chao has finally come! Although so it is just temporary. And I finally get to say goodbye to that ugly Buurin. Eh? What happens to you guys? You need Buurin`s help now? Rats, so Buurin has to come again...

I just need some more pearls, then I`d have got all 108 I need. What`s the matter Ton-chan? We should both be happy. Isn`t it true that once all the pearls are here Ton-chan will get to inherit the throne? Why do you keep interfering!? And it looks like Ton-chan wants to break up with me!!

Kuroha`s home is finally revealed with fanfare. Everything I saw are super luxury. She also served a great special dinner, but someone has something stuck in her throat. What`s it Kuroha? You have been uneasy for some time already. Huh? Your father and mother only come home once a year?

We went through a forbidden basement, into a mysterious world. Among those profusely blooming flowers, a devilish smile floats. Please! Promise me! Never look back! A dreadful monster is attacking us!

titles.title: Aku no Hanazono ga Warau Toki

REGULAR.description: The monsters finally broke out of Kuroha`s mansion, and are heading towards downtown. They go into various things and keep attacking people again and again. They even have us all cornered...! What can I do for everybody? Before you guys... before you guys I cannot transform!!

titles.title: 危機! 狙われた学園

REGULAR.description: This is Buurin`s final transformation. I can never change back to Karin again.

titles.title: 涙のメタモルフォーゼ

REGULAR.description: Six more Buurins are needed to protect the seven talismans? That said, but there`s only one Buurin and that`s me. But this world will soon be taken over by devils. I have no choice but to use the final resort! Ton-chan! Everyone! Please, lend me your strengths!!

titles.title: Ai to Yuuki no Pig Girl Tonde Buurin
บูริน หมูอวกาศ
愛と勇気のピッグガール とんでぶーりん
Pig Girl of Love and Courage
